name: Elixir of Pain
summary: Forsaken apothecaries at Tarren Mill brew the Elixir of Pain for dangerous experiments. The mixture tests biological agents meant to advance Lady Sylvanas's darker ambitions.

sections.title: Apothecary Experimentation
sections.body: The Royal Apothecary Society seeks formulas to strengthen the Forsaken against their mortal neighbors and the Scourge. The Elixir of Pain is one such trial, made with freshly harvested ingredients from around the Hillsbrad Foothills. Its living subjects matter little to its makers; the potion tests volatile substances meant to aid the Dark Lady.

sections.title: Field Testing on Stanley
sections.body: The apothecaries seek a quiet test before risking military assets or exposing their work to Hillsbrad's defenders. They give the Elixir of Pain to Stanley, Farmer Ray's seemingly harmless domestic dog at the northern farmstead of Hillsbrad Fields. The brew does not kill him quietly. It mutates Stanley into an enraged, monstrous beast.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Elixir of Pain?
faq.answer: The Elixir of Pain tests biological compounds for the Royal Apothecary Society. Its creators hope these mixtures will eventually yield devastating concoctions for Lady Sylvanas and secure Forsaken dominance.
Stanley is Farmer Ray's pet dog at the northern farm in Hillsbrad Fields. Forsaken apothecaries choose the seemingly harmless domestic dog as an unsuspecting subject for their new elixir.

faq.q: Why is the elixir tested on Stanley?
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon wants to test his newly mixed elixir in the field, so he sends it to Farmer Ray's little dog Stanley to see how the animal responds.

aliases: where do i take the elixir
faq.answer: The test takes place outside Farmer Ray's northern farmhouse in Hillsbrad Fields, southwest of Tarren Mill. Stanley usually rests near the front porch.

angles.text: The Royal Apothecary Society's callous field trials show the Forsaken's willingness to use any means necessary to develop chemical weapons against the living.
Forsaken allies may witness the unsettling methods used by Tarren Mill's researchers during these grim tests.
